title: Porsche And Audi EVs Can Use Tesla Superchargers, With One Exception (InsideEVs)
notes: 2025-09-08: e-tron GT, Q6 e-tron and A6 e-tron gain Supercharger access; all other Audi/Porsche EVs compatible except Q4 e-tron; Canada same date; Audi EVs lack a NACS port so an adapter is needed; new 2025 Q6, A6 Sportback and e-tron GT include one; adapter sale to existing owners not announced.
